items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Louis Primo, the other Primo played in Tartarich's orchestra

ctx.x: Yeah, he worked at the second-

Yeah, he worked at the second- practically working every day. You remember when the Cobbs had an orchestra and they had this place over there on Tartarich's had a little orchestra in there, Louis Primo, the other Primo played in Tartarich's orchestra, in a restaurant and they had down there in the quarter a couple of them in there. But if he came over there and recorded that section and it slipped my mind over there. Well when you hear it you can probably tell us who the vocalists are. Because a lot of the stuff…
I can't remember Red Bowman as a singer.
